sloka: अपश्यम्स् तु ततः तत्र पितरम् पितुर् आलये ।जगाम भरतः द्रष्टुम् मातरम् मातुर् आलये ॥२-७२-१॥
transliteration: apaśyams tu tataḥ tatra pitaram pitur ālaye ।jagāma bharataḥ draṣṭum mātaram mātur ālaye ॥2-72-1॥

translations.english: Not finding his father in his abode, Bharata went to see his mother in her apartment.
